annotations.title: Actor-Target Threat Score (Capability x Opportunity x Intent)

description: Deterministic capability x opportunity x intent threat score for an actor-target pairing. Scored from actor/CVE/campaign data plus GDELT geopolitical tension and OFAC sanctions pressure. Not LLM-generated. Price: $0.04 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: ICS threat actor name e.g. SANDWORM, VOLTZITE, XENOTIME

region.description: Target region or country e.g. Europe, GCC, Ukraine

sector.description: Target sector e.g. energy, water, manufacturing

vendor_stack.description: Comma-separated OT/ICS vendors in the target environment e.g. Siemens,Schneider Electric. Pass 'none' if unknown.
